name: aria.dev/skills/usage-conformance
description: Checks NormalizedUsageRecord data against governance policies (providers, models, regions, attribution, cost confidence) and evaluates scoped budget limits.
triggers: Check our LLM usage against the approved model list
Are any records running in non-approved regions?
Evaluate this month's spend against team budgets
usage: Call check_governance_conformance with records and a policy object; evaluate_budget_policy with records and budgets [{scope,id,limit_usd}]; list_policy_rules to enumerate supported rules.
